The dish looks like a paper plate or bowl about 15-16 cm across, filled with almonds in a heap.

Almonds weigh about 1.2 g each, and the pile looks like roughly 60-70 of them. A bowl of that size holding a mounded layer of almonds would be around 80-90 g. At about 5.8 kcal/g (580-600 kcal per 100 g), 85 g comes to about 495 kcal.

I'll use 85 g and about 490 kcal.

{"kcal": 490, "mass_g": 85}
